capabilities: Suggest notes reachable in 2+ hops from the anchor note but not yet linked to it
Walk vault links treating backlinks and outlinks the same
Show suggestions as a flat list or as a nested chain of walk paths
Anchor the walk on the active markdown note or an opened PDF tab
Dock the viewer below or beside the note and follow it as you write
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Hop-Link Viewer provides a clean, text-first alternative
problem: Obsidian's local graph view is cluttered and unintuitive to refer to while writing, and backlinks and outlinks only show direct connections.
summary: Link-walk viewer that suggests notes up to N hops from the active note that are not yet directly linked to it.
